title: Studio Data pillar panels and ResourceEditPage: a CEL parse-fault hold still ends when the tab or selection changes; port the draft-stamped hold ruled on #27485
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. The maintainer's ruling on #27485 (comment 6500685972, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-29T15:17Z), item 3: "Sibling surfaces are NOT widened in this PR: the Data pillar's panel family (objectui#4527, tab-keyed) and the environment door `ResourceEditPage` (selection-keyed) keep their mechanism until their own card. `domain:ui#3` files that card: S/M, `domain:ui` · `area:formula`, "port the draft-stamped CEL hold to the Data pillar's panel family and to ResourceEditPage", with the residual `flush`-inside-250-ms edge named in it. Not paired with this PR."

## What is wrong

The ruling on #27485 makes a CEL parse-fault hold belong to the draft: it lasts while the draft still carries the text the editor judged, and ends when that text is edited, the item is removed or the buffer reloads. PR #27617 does that for the Data pillar's field inspector only. Two sibling surfaces keep the old selection-keyed mechanism, so the same defect form stays there (read from the code, not yet measured on these surfaces; PR #27617 Acceptance notes 5). The first step of the card is one measured repro on each:

- **Data pillar panel family** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the panel report next to `blockingReport`, objectui#4527): the Validations, Actions and Settings panels report their CEL faults keyed by tab. Leaving the tab with a broken expression in the draft zeroes the count, so the autosave would send the broken text.
- **`ResourceEditPage`** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `inspectorBlocking = blockingReport.key === selectionKey ? … : 0`): changing the selection releases the hold the same way.

Expected (per the ruling): the same rule as the field inspector after #27617. A kept verdict stamped to the judged text holds the save with the inspector or panel closed; the held line names the item with a "Show me" that reopens it; editing the text, removing the item or reloading ends the hold; the open editor's live verdict always wins. ⛔ No dialog on close, no silent revert, no second autosave path, no change to `useDraftAutoSave`'s timer or single-flight (ruling item 4).

## Residual edge to name and close

The editors lint 250 ms after the last keystroke. A `flush` (the Data rail switch from #27511) inside that window can read the previous verdict; reopening a held item reports 0 for about 250 ms until its lint runs. The timer path is safe (a falling `blocked` re-arms a fresh 1.5 s), so only `flush` inside the window can reach the server. PR #27617 Acceptance notes 4 records it.

## Business reason

Every Studio and environment-admin author who writes a validation rule, action condition or resource CEL expression: closing or switching is the usual way to finish an edit, and today it lets a predicate the engine refuses into the draft, surfacing only at publish with no item named (QA checklist `studio-authoring.expression-editors` P1 acceptance[4], negative[1]). AI-authored expressions fail to parse routinely (ADR-0033), so the loud, named hold matters most there.

## Who acts

`domain:ui` seat 3 dispatches it after PR #27617 merges (it reuses that PR's `fieldCelStamp` / kept-verdict shape). `ResourceEditPage` sits in metadata-admin, shared with ui seat 2's admin pages: the claim declares it.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` "CEL hold released when panel closes or tab changes, Data pillar panel family ResourceEditPage" on objectstack-ai/objectstack: 2 hits (#27485 open, the field inspector, ruled; #26705 closed, held edits dropped on pillar leave). Neither covers these surfaces.

Size: S/M (ruling). Related: #27485, #27511, PR #27617, objectui#4306, objectui#4527.
